name: Pioneriada
source:
Get ready for a journey that lasts an Eternity!

The heroes of the story have long since, and more than once, managed to escape from their "Everlasting Summer," but each of them has always returned. Time and again, a new story and accompanying misadventures awaited them.

After all the endings that occurred, the characters find themselves in the camp once again, and once again, they have to meet the exact same Semyon. But is everything the same as it was back then?

Some begin to look for someone's malicious intent in this mess. Others refuse to do anything and accept this state of affairs. And only a single Pioneer wanders along his mysterious paths, the purpose of which is not yet meant to be understood by any of the camp residents.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2585264824]Steam[/url]]
translation:
准备好踏上永恒的旅程吧！

故事中的英雄们早已且不止一次地成功逃离了“永恒的夏天”，但他们每个人总是会回来。一次又一次，新的故事和随之而来的不幸遭遇等待着他们。

在发生了所有的结局之后，角色们发现自己再次回到了营地，并且再次遇到了完全相同的谢苗。但一切还和以前一样吗？

有些人开始在这场混乱中寻找某人的恶意。其他人则拒绝采取任何行动并接受这种状况。只有一名先锋在他神秘的道路上徘徊，其目的尚未被任何营地居民理解。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2585264824]Steam[/url]]
